status: Generated pixel fan-art pack; existing accepted style retained with dedicated expressions and stationary gestures

generation.intent: New unofficial Nino fan art in a fixed low-resolution pixel style; no third-party sprite pixels copied

stages.reason_for_refinement: Opposite contact/passing leg phase was insufficiently distinct in bottom two frames

stages.stage: blink, talk, happy, annoyed, shy, sit

design.version: short pink bob; black and teal butterfly ribbons; blue eyes; black cardigan, white shirt, green skirt, white socks, black loafers
design.proportions: Approximately 2.7 heads tall, sparse small eyes and flat material color clusters
design.default_expression: Neutral small closed mouth with open blue eyes; annoyed is a separate optional state

operations: Crop observed generated character bounds at alpha >= 128
Nearest-neighbor resample to a fixed logical grid; no smoothing
Threshold alpha to 0 or 255 and map RGB to a fixed 31-color material palette with no dithering
Place every pose in a transparent 96x112 frame with grounded anchor (48,108)
Use the generated talk frame as the identical standing body; literal generated face-region crops provide blink/happy/annoyed/shy; a generated closed-mouth crop provides idle
Keep four independently generated right-walk poses with contact/passing and opposite leg/arm phases
Create four left-walk poses by exact horizontal pixel mirroring, not new generated drawings
Pack fifteen RGBA frames into a 480x336 atlas and export individual non-interlaced RGBA8 PNGs
processing.encoding: PNG 8-bit RGBA, color type 6, interlace 0; palette is only a color restriction, not indexed PNG encoding

operations: Crop each observed generated pose at alpha >=128
Nearest-neighbor resample to 104px contact / 105px passing opaque height
Apply unchanged original 31-color palette without dithering and binary alpha
Place soles at y=108 in 96x112 logical frames
Append down and up poses in new atlas rows four and five
Crop four independently generated poses at alpha>=128
Nearest-neighbor scale each generated character to 104px opaque height
Map to unchanged 31-color palette without dithering; binary alpha
Keep generated upper-body pixels in [0,0,96,58], preserve exact idle lower-body pixels in [0,58,96,112]
Append four poses at row six, first four cells, preserving old atlas top five rows
Crop 8 generated expression faces and 16 independently generated gesture poses
Nearest-neighbor resample and restrict to unchanged 31-color palette with binary alpha
Register soles at (48,108), retain canonical idle body outside expression face crops
Retain exact canonical idle legs at y>=80 underneath generated gesture upper bodies
Append at row seven, preserving the full original six rows and all old PNG bytes

limitations: The artwork is AI-generated and technically normalized, not commissioned hand-pixelled art; style acceptance remains the user's decision.
Four rightward 3/4 walk poses are generated; leftward walking is a mirror and is not four additional original drawings.
Minor hair/skirt silhouette variation remains between walk poses, and the side view is a three-quarter view.
Speaking alternates one open mouth and one closed mouth; it is not phoneme or amplitude lip sync.
The 64x80 technical draft lost eye readability, so the selected export uses 96x112 logical pixels.
No desktop-app integration, GPU task, TTS playback or browser launch was performed by this asset task.

Eight new expressions have dedicated generated face crops; four stationary gestures each have four generated upper-body poses with canonical planted legs. This is generated and technically normalized fan art, not hand-pixelled author artwork.
